content.description: 给定一个由左右括号组成的序列 $s$，求其最长合法括号子序列（我们定义空串也是一种合法括号序列）。
content.formatI: 一行一个字符串，保证由左右括号组成。
content.formatO: 一行一个正整数，表示答案。

en.name: Regular Bracket Sequence
en.description:
A bracket sequence is called regular if it is possible to obtain correct arithmetic expression by inserting characters «+» and «1» into this sequence. For example, sequences «(())()», «()» and «(()(()))» are regular, while «)(», «(()» and «(()))(» are not.

One day Johnny got bracket sequence. He decided to remove some of the brackets from it in order to obtain a regular bracket sequence. What is the maximum length of a regular bracket sequence which can be obtained?
en.formatI: Input consists of a single line with non-empty string of «(» and «)» characters. Its length does not exceed $ 10^{6} $ .
en.formatO: Output the maximum possible length of a regular bracket sequence.
